title: oldenlandia viscida
intro: Oldenlandia viscida, commonly known as Hedyotis viscida or Hedyotis diffusa var. viscida, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Oldenlandia viscida include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory and antioxidant effects, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of Oldenlandia viscida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
